q1.explanationZh: 名词 police“警察”，作主语时谓语用复数；the police 指“警察部门；警方”。

q2.explanationZh: policeman“（男）警察”，复数把 man 变成 men：policemen。

q3.explanationZh: policy 名词“政策；方针”，复数 policies。

q4.explanationZh: polish 及物动词“擦亮”，polish the shoes“擦鞋”。

q5.explanationZh: polite 形容词“有礼貌的”，反义词 impolite。

q6.explanationZh: political 形容词“政治的”，political rights“政治权利”。

q7.explanationZh: politic(s) 加 -ian 表示“……的人”：politician“政治家”。

q8.explanationZh: politics“政治”以 -s 结尾，但通常作单数用。

q9.explanationZh: pollute 及物动词“污染”，形容词 polluted“受污染的”。

q10.explanationZh: pollute 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 pollution“污染”。

q11.explanationZh: pond 名词“池塘”，a fish pond“鱼塘”。

q12.explanationZh: pool 名词“水池”，a swimming pool“游泳池”。

q13.explanationZh: poor 形容词“贫穷的；可怜的”，名词 poverty“贫穷”。

q14.explanationZh: pop 是 popular 的简短形式，形容词“流行的”，名词“流行音乐”。

q15.explanationZh: popcorn 是合成词：pop（爆）+ corn（玉米）。

q16.explanationZh: popular 形容词“流行的；受欢迎的”，be popular with“受……欢迎”。

q17.explanationZh: population 名词“人口”，have a population of...“有……人口”。

q18.explanationZh: pork“猪肉”是不可数名词；pig 是“猪”。

q21.explanationZh: port（拿）+ -able（能……的）= portable“便于携带的”。

q22.explanationZh: port（搬运）+ -er（人）= porter“搬运工；门卫”。

q23.explanationZh: portion 名词“一部分；一份”，a portion of“……的一部分”。

q24.explanationZh: portrait 名词“肖像，画像”，a portrait of sb.“某人的肖像”。

q25.explanationZh: pose 动词“摆好姿势”，名词“姿势”；pose a threat 意为“构成威胁”。

q26.explanationZh: position 名词“位置；职位”，apply for a position“申请职位”。

q27.explanationZh: positive 形容词“积极的”，反义词 negative“消极的”。

q28.explanationZh: possess 及物动词“拥有”，注意两组双写 ss。

q29.explanationZh: possess 加 -ion 构成名词 possession“拥有；财产”。

q30.explanationZh: possible 变 -ble 为 -bility，构成名词 possibility“可能性”。

q31.explanationZh: possible 形容词“可能的”，反义词 impossible。

q32.explanationZh: post 有三组意思：①柱；张贴、发布 ②邮政；邮寄 ③职位，拼写都是 post。

q33.explanationZh: the police 指“警察部门；警方”，要加 the。

q34.explanationZh: polish the shoes“擦鞋”，polish 意为“擦亮”。

q35.explanationZh: 形容词 political 修饰名词 rights：political rights。

q36.explanationZh: a fish pond“鱼塘”，fish 作定语修饰 pond。

q38.explanationZh: be popular with sb.“受某人欢迎”，介词用 with。

q39.explanationZh: a portion of“……的一部分”，property“财产”。

q40.explanationZh: a portrait of sb.“某人的肖像”，介词用 of。

q42.explanationZh: possess the property“拥有财产”，possess 意为“拥有”。

accept: It is possible for sb. to do
It is possible for sb. to do ...

q43.explanationZh: It is possible for sb. to do sth.“某人可能做某事”，it 是形式主语。

q44.explanationZh: It is possible that...“可能……”，that 引导主语从句。

q45.explanationZh: apply for“申请”，post 这里指“职位”。

q46.explanationZh: be polite to sb.“对某人有礼貌”，介词用 to。

q47.explanationZh: the pollution of sth.“……的污染”，介词用 of。

q48.explanationZh: “有 200 多名警察在执勤”，police 本身表示复数，也可用 policeman 的复数 policemen。

q49.explanationZh: such a + 形容词 + 名词，修饰 clerk 用形容词 polite“有礼貌的”。

q50.explanationZh: “最有手腕的政治家”，most skilful 后接名词 politician。

q51.explanationZh: 看电视时“吃爆米花”，eat popcorn。

q52.explanationZh: has 后用过去分词构成现在完成时，post“张贴”→ posted。

q53.explanationZh: 提着行李找人帮忙，找的是“搬运工”porter。

q54.explanationZh: pop songs“流行歌曲”，位于句首要大写 Pop。

q55.explanationZh: fight 后接名词作宾语，“与污染作斗争”fight pollution。

q56.explanationZh: how much 修饰不可数名词，包饺子要用“猪肉”pork。

q57.explanationZh: Is it possible to do...?“有可能……吗？”，it 是形式主语。

q58.sampleAnswer: The old man was thankful to the policeman who found the lost car for him.
references: The old man was thankful to the policeman who found the lost car for him.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “感激某人”= be thankful to sb.；who 引导定语从句修饰 policeman。

q59.sampleAnswer: That city has a population of over ten million.
references: That city has a population of over ten million.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “有……人口”= have a population of...；1000 万 = ten million。

q60.sampleAnswer: After reading the reports about this astronaut, it dawned on me that as long as one dares to dream and works diligently to fulfill that dream, life holds infinite possibilities.
references: After reading the reports about this astronaut, it dawned on me that as long as one dares to dream and works diligently to fulfill that dream, life holds infinite possibilities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “我逐渐意识到”= it dawned on me that...；“只要”= as long as；“无限可能”= infinite possibilities。

q61.sampleAnswer: Politics was one of his university subjects.
references: Politics was one of his university subjects.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: politics 作主语时谓语用单数；“……之一”= one of + 复数名词。

q62.sampleAnswer: The environment will be seriously polluted if people don’t take any action.
references: The environment will be seriously polluted if people don’t take any action.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “环境被污染”用被动语态 be polluted；if 条件句用一般现在时表将来。

q63.sampleAnswer: The police remind the public to be careful not to fall for scams because nowadays there are many types of influencer marketing.
references: The police remind the public to be careful not to fall for scams because nowadays there are many types of influencer marketing.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: the police 作主语，谓语用复数 remind；remind sb. to do sth.“提醒某人做某事”；“上当受骗”可用 fall for scams。

q64.sampleAnswer: On cold winter mornings, a hot bowl of porridge is especially comforting.
references: On cold winter mornings, a hot bowl of porridge is especially comforting.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “一碗热粥”= a hot bowl of porridge；comforting“令人安慰的”。

q65.sampleAnswer: The manager was pleased with the new policy, believing it was an effective way to promote the products.
references: The manager was pleased with the new policy, believing it was an effective way to promote the products.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “对……满意”= be pleased with；believing... 是现在分词作伴随状语。

q66.sampleAnswer: Our English teacher has a good sense of humor and that is why his lessons are so popular with the students.
references: Our English teacher has a good sense of humor and that is why his lessons are so popular with the students.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “富有幽默感”= have a good sense of humour；“受……欢迎”= be popular with。

q67.sampleAnswer: The company has made it clear that only those who have a good command of computer skills can apply for this position.
references: The company has made it clear that only those who have a good command of computer skills can apply for this position.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “明确表示”= make it clear that...；“精通”= have a good command of；“申请职位”= apply for a position。
